title: HtmlDd
responsibility: Renders the native dd element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDd.attributes
inputs.description: Native dd attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDd.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native dd element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDd
outputs.description: The actual native dd element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
